why: To hear the notes you play, Fermata listens through the microphone; the sound never leaves this device.
asking: Your browser is asking whether Fermata may use the microphone.
here: With the microphone on, the notes you play are added to your answer.
on: Play the notes one at a time and let each one ring.
idle: The microphone turned itself off: no note was heard for three minutes.
onScreen: You can still answer on the screen.

problem.refused: The microphone is blocked for Fermata. To allow it, open this site's settings (beside the address, or your phone's settings for this browser).
problem.missing: No microphone was found on this device.
problem.unsupported: This browser can't use a microphone here.
problem.busy: The microphone couldn't start: another app may be using it.
problem.hidden: Listening stopped because Fermata was no longer on screen (for example, you switched to another app or tab).
problem.ended: The microphone was disconnected, so listening stopped.
